tagline: A small window onto what you are seeing.
question: What would you like to know?
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
eyebrow: A quiet window for the screen in front of you
intro: Choose a screen, app window, or browser tab. Your image is sent to the selected provider when you ask.
popupNote: The popup fallback may not stay above other apps. Document Picture-in-Picture is supported in some browsers.
frozen: Frame frozen. Select an area, redact, or ask a question.
dragHint: Drag to select. Arrow keys move. Shift + arrows resize. Enter applies. Escape cancels.
copyError: Could not copy. Check clipboard permission.
costNote: Actual cost depends on provider, model, image size, and plan. Six calls per minute can reach 360 requests per hour.
privacyNote: Masks are opaque in sent images. The provider receives each image you ask about.
reopen: Session unavailable. Reopen the panel from your coding session.
rateLimit: Passive request limit reached for this minute.
cleared: History, pins, and in-memory key cleared.
returnOpener: Panel open in its own window
localCapture: Local screen capture · provider receives images when asked
statusDemoReady: Demo fixture · prerecorded text · no provider calls.
statusLiveReady: Live preview is ready. Freeze a frame before selecting or redacting.
statusPassiveAdded: A short passive note was added.
statusAnswerReady: Answer ready. The provider receives the image when you ask.
statusShareFirst: Share a screen first, then freeze a frame.
statusFixtureAnswer: Fixture demo · prerecorded answer · no provider call.
statusPopupBlocked: Popup blocked. Allow pop-ups for this page and reopen the panel.
passivePrompt: Briefly describe the meaningful change in this screen.
summaryPrompt: Summarize the recent passive notes from the last ten minutes.
demoAnswer: The fixture shows a Save control at the lower right. This prerecorded answer makes no provider call.
errorCliMissing: The coding assistant CLI was not found. Install it or switch to the API backend.
errorApiAuth: API authentication failed. Check the key in Settings.
errorApiKeyMissing: Add an API key in Settings, or choose the CLI backend.
errorProvider: The answer could not be completed. Check the selected backend and try again.
errorTimeout: The answer took too long. Try a shorter question.
errorBusy: An answer is already running. Wait or cancel it.
errorImage: The image could not be processed. Share a smaller surface or freeze another frame.
errorNotesEmpty: There are no passive notes from the last ten minutes.
errorLimit: The passive request limit was reached. It will resume next minute.
errorProtocol: The selected backend returned an incomplete answer. Try again.
errorCapture: The shared surface is unavailable. Share a screen again.
errorQuestion: Enter a question of up to 2,000 characters.
errorSessionLimit: Too many panels are open. Close an older panel and try again.
popupFallbackHelp: The floating window could not open. Open a popup instead.
answerCancelExplanation: The answer was stopped before it finished.
statusAnswerCancelled: Answer cancelled. Your question is still here.
resizeHelp: Drag to resize, or use the arrow keys. You can also drag the window edges.
